1 Load libraries

pacman::p_load(sf, ggstatsplot, tmap, tidyverse, knitr, GWmodel)

GWmodel presently is build around the plder sp and not sf formats for handling spatial data in R.

2 Importing data

hunan_sf <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
Reading layer `Hunan' from data source 
  `/Users/cathyc/Documents/cathyschu/ISSS626GEO/In-class_Ex/data/geospatial' 
  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
Simple feature collection with 88 features and 7 fields
Geometry type: POLYGON
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 108.7831 ymin: 24.6342 xmax: 114.2544 ymax: 30.12812
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")

3 Join datasets Hunan and Hunan_2012

hunan_sf <- left_join(hunan_sf, hunan2012) %>% #this match by county
  select(1:3, 7, 15, 16, 31,32)
hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
  as_Spatial()

4 Compute bandwidth

4.1 Cross-validation (CV)

Will generate a score. It goes through iterations, and then stops at 76.29123. The return is 76.29126, in KM.

bw_CV <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1, data = hunan_sp,
                approach = "CV", adaptive = FALSE,
                kernel = "bisquare", longlat = T) #input data is in latlong

4.2 AIC

AIC is the alternative method. Return is bigger: 160.5517, in KM.

bw_AIC <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ 1, data = hunan_sp,
                approach = "AIC", adaptive = FALSE,
                kernel = "bisquare", longlat = T) #input data is in latlong
Fixed bandwidth: 357.4897 AICc value: 1927.631 
Fixed bandwidth: 220.985 AICc value: 1921.547 
Fixed bandwidth: 136.6204 AICc value: 1919.993 
Fixed bandwidth: 84.48025 AICc value: 1940.603

bw_AIC
[1] 160.5517

Compute fixed bandwidth

gwstat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp, vars = "GDPPC",
               bw = bw_AIC, kernel = "bisquare",
               adaptive = FALSE, longlat = T)

Convert to a daraframe

Extract SDF data table from gwss object output from gwss(). It will be converted into data.frame using as.data.frame().

gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstat$SDF)

Then use cbind() to append the newly derived data.frame onto hunan_sf sf data.frame.

hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)
# Summary of LISA results
summary(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LM)   # Local Moran's I values
   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
  14259   18172   23683   24724   28169   47833 
summary(hunan_gstat$GDPPC_LSD)  # Standard deviation

   3572    6343    9779   11411   16462   22583

-0.1181  1.0567  1.4006  1.5864  2.0757  3.8782

Visualise geographically weighted statistics

LM <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons("GDPPC_LM") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_title("GDPPC Local Moran")

LSD <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) + 
  tm_polygons("GDPPC_LSD") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_title("Local Standard Deviation")

LSKe <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) +
  tm_polygons("GDPPC_LSKe") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_title("GDPPC Local Skewness")

LVar <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) + 
  tm_polygons("GDPPC_LVar") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_title("Local Variance")

LCV <- tm_shape(hunan_gstat) + 
  tm_polygons("GDPPC_LCV") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_title("Local Coefficient of Variation")

tmap_arrange(LM, LSD, LSKe, LVar, LCV, asp = 1, ncol = 1)
